title: Disclaimer
seoDescription: What filecompresser does and does not guarantee: limits of browser-based processing, backup responsibility, and when to keep your originals.

sections.heading: Your files stay on your device
body: Processing happens in your browser. Your file is read into that browser tab, processed there, and handed back to you. It is not transmitted to us. This is a technical property of how the tools are built, not a policy promise — there is no upload endpoint to send it to.

sections.heading: Keep your own backups
body: Because nothing is stored, nothing is recoverable either. If a result is wrong, or your browser crashes mid-process, the original file is the only copy. Keep a backup of anything you cannot afford to re-download before using these tools on it.

sections.heading: Compression is not always compression
body: Some formats cannot be made meaningfully smaller at the selected settings. For ordinary compression, a candidate that is not smaller is discarded and the original is returned unchanged with 0% reduction, including its existing metadata. Explicit format conversions, resizing and ZIP creation can increase bytes and are reported separately. No result is padded, truncated or renamed to manufacture a saving.
Audio re-encoded to MP3 and video re-encoded to H.264 are genuinely lossy. They are appropriate for web delivery and email, but they are not archival replacements for the original.

sections.heading: No warranty of results
body: These tools are provided as-is. We do not guarantee any particular compression ratio, output quality, or availability. If a result matters — a document you must deliver, a video you must publish — check the output before you rely on it.

sections.heading: Browser and device limits
body: A browser tab has less memory than a desktop application, and less again on a phone. Very large videos and PDFs can exhaust the memory a browser will give a single page, particularly on mobile. When that happens you get a clear error and your original is untouched. This is a device constraint, not a limit on file types.

sections.heading: Not professional advice
body: Nothing on this site is legal, medical, or financial advice. This is a file utility.

sections.heading: Liability
body: To the fullest extent the law allows, filecompresser is provided as-is, without warranty of any kind. The operators of this site are not liable for lost files, lost data, corrupted output, or any loss arising from your use of the tools.
Because your files never leave your device, that is also your only backup. Nothing here is a substitute for keeping your own copy of anything you cannot afford to lose.

If you are relying on these tools for something contractual, regulated or otherwise consequential — filing a document, submitting evidence, publishing under a deadline — check the output, and consider whether you need professional advice first.
